role: Gate: replays the oracle's HarvestDropsProbe breaks (3x3x3 context, held stack, world Random seed) through csrc/engine/harvestdrops.c and compares the context after, the held stack, exhaustion, three stat counters and every dropped entity's stack, position, motion and yaw. --cases N (make smoke): the first N cases.

structs.name: rec_ent
structs.java: one recorded dropped entity (EntityItem stack, position, motion, yaw)

notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/harvestdrops. Native calls: harvestdrops_break (csrc/engine/harvestdrops.c), can_harvest_block, jr_seed/jr_double for the shared Math.random stream (resynchronised after each case by four nextDouble per recorded entity), nbt_parse/nbt_render. world_draws is not compared (drops.c takes the dropBlockAsItem call as a seed). Per-block overrides exercised by the probe include BlockDeadBush, BlockDoublePlant, BlockIce, BlockLeaves, BlockTallGrass, BlockSnow, BlockVine, BlockTripWire (from HarvestDropsProbe.java). Oracle side: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/HarvestDropsProbe.java. Recordings: out/java/harvestdrops/s2, s42. rec_ent field names summarised, not copied.
